India braces for weather shifts with monsoon activity and heatwaves

Various regions across India are experiencing significant weather changes, with some areas anticipating monsoon rains and relief from heat, while others face warnings of storms, lightning, and continued heatwaves. The India Meteorological Department has issued forecasts indicating potential rainfall and shifts in temperature patterns across several states. These developments are crucial as the country navigates the pre-monsoon and monsoon seasons, impacting daily life and agricultural activities.
